title: Carney Says Fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta Killed 4 and Injured Dozens
summary_full: Prime Minister Mark Carney said the “violent, fast-moving” fire on Saturday in Alberta was one of the worst tragedies for Canada’s armed forces in peacetime on Canadian soil.
